name: XML Formatter
summary: Pretty-print or minify XML with consistent indentation — locally in your browser.
description: Paste XML to beautify nested elements with 2- or 4-space indent. Preserve declarations, comments, and CDATA. Optionally minify back into the input. Formatting is best-effort and runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Does it validate XML?
faqs.answer: No. It focuses on indentation and readability. Invalid markup is still formatted best-effort.

faqs.question: Are CDATA sections preserved?
faqs.answer: Yes. CDATA blocks are kept intact during format and minify.

faqs.question: Is my XML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
